messages:
dylan: heads-up — spotted quality regressions in the canary for gptx-2-quant after yesterday's runtime rollout. samples show truncated completions and odd token repetition.

priya: can you paste a minimal example + canary percentage?

dylan: canary at 3%. example: ```
input: \"Summarize the following email:
...\"
old-runtime (v3.1.1): \"TL;DR: ...\"
new-runtime (v3.2.0): \"TL;DR: TL;DR: TL;DR ...\"
logs: kvcache misses spike around step 12
```

anna: thanks. looks like KV cache warming behavior changed. low-latency models with short prefixes would degrade.

matt: is this specific to the quantized kernel path? arnav on infra picked it up earlier?

arnav: yep, repros only on q4_* builds with the fused-attn kernel. SDK and model binaries unchanged. looks like the runtime kernel selection changed heuristics.

kate: given product impact, recommend immediate pin of runtime for gptx-2-quant to last known-good (v3.1.2) and pause further rollouts for quantized variants. can we do a scoped pin via deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: @kate I can apply a metadata pin. Command: `deploy-bot pin runtime --version=3.1.2 --selector=model:gptx-2-quant --reason=\"KV cache regression on fused-attn\"`

priya: please run the pin and scale canary back to 0% while we investigate. also add a note to release notes.

deploy-bot: running pin now...

deploy-bot: ✅ runtime pinned for selector `model:gptx-2-quant` -> version 3.1.2 (applied by priya). canary traffic reverted to 0%. audit id: pin-1968504321-a1

ops-bot: alert created in #incidents: INC-2026-314 — \"gptx-2-quant quality regression; runtime pinned\". Pager duty notified (oncall: matt).

matt: acknowledged, investigating rollout diff. quick plan: 1) collect failing prompts + KV cache traces, 2) reproduce locally against fused-attn change, 3) either patch kernel heuristics + release hotfix or keep pin until next safe rollout.

anna: for the release notes: add an entry under \"known issues\" and mention the scoped runtime pin and that users on dedicated/private should contact support to request the pin.

priya: I'll add a short post to the status page and coordinate with support. who will own the kernel fix? arnav?

arnav: i'll own the repro & patch. ETA 48h for root-cause + small fix, 72h for canary validation. if we need to fast-track a hotfix, request an emergency change window.

kate: schedule: hold other runtime rollouts for quantized models until canary green. Matt, set a rollback threshold in case pin fails.

matt: set automated rollback if >2% user-impacting errors in 1h. I'll add that to the deploy config.

priya: created draft note in #product-release-drafts with the pin details and recommended customer messaging. link: https://internal.redwood/status/inc-1968504321

dylan: thanks all. once arnav posts repro + patch PR, let's run a controlled canary (1% -> 5% -> 20%) and monitor perplexity + KV hit rate.

arnav: PR coming in ~6h. I'll tag @matt and @priya for canary signoff.

kate: good coordination. closing thread after we see canary passing post-hotfix. :white_check_mark:
